channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: U. Oregon socialists demand abortion drugs on campus
item.description: Socialist students want abortions on campus - a pro-life group said the school should support moms in need instead.

item.title: Chicago schools refuse to hire Christian college student teachers despite lawsuit
item.description: The Moody Bible Institute is suing Chicago Public Schools for religious discrimination after being denied participation in the student teacher program due to its Christian hiring practices. A U.S. Congressional leader is also looking into the conflict.

item.title: Half of Portland State U. students are LGBT, survey says
item.description: Half of Portland State University students are not heterosexual, survey finds.

item.title: University of Minnesota edits public statement about Alex Pretti after backlash
item.description: University of Minnesota leaders have tweaked their public statement about the death of Alex Pretti after online observers on both sides criticized their written response on the death of the protester at the hands of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers.

item.title: ‘Texans first’: Governor freezes worker visas for universities
item.description: Governor Greg Abbott declares state entities should put 'Texans first,' not foreign workers.

item.title: Trump admin finds SJSU violated Title IX by allowing male on women’s volleyball team
item.description: Feds demand university apologize to female athletes, order policy overhaul.

item.title: Be wary of biased and false information – from professors
item.description: Be wary of biased and false information – from professors

item.title: Late-term abortion facility scrubs Georgetown from website after denying affiliation
item.description: A Maryland abortion facility recently removed a reference to Georgetown University in a "training" section on its website after The College Fix began asking questions. The Catholic institution strongly denied ever having had a relationship with the abortion facility.

item.title: Indian students reach settlement with CU Boulder over ‘pungent’ food dispute
item.description: Two Indian graduate students recently settled a lawsuit with CU Boulder over allegedly discriminatory treatment related to them heating Indian food in a department microwave.

item.title: Harvard-backed program drops ‘students of color’ requirement after legal complaint
item.description: A Harvard-backed summer scholarship program accused of racial discrimination quietly revised its eligibility language after a legal complaint, but critics told The College Fix the change came too late.
